FY2025 10-K R4: "Amortization and impairment of intangible assets | 775 | 291 | 151" (2025 2024 2023); R102 Intangible Assets - Additional Information: "Impairment charges | $ 0" (12 months ended Dec. 31, 2025); MD&A critical accounting estimates: "the Company's amortization expense, which was $775 million, $241 million and $151 million for 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively". Pure amortization 2025 = 775 (stated in text).

FY2025 10-K R9 cash flows: "Depreciation and amortization | 1,126 | 529 | 427" (2025 2024 2023). The printed caption is plain "Depreciation and amortization" (no accretion named); the same caption/element carries 529 for 2024 in both the FY2024 and FY2025 10-Ks. Components stated in text: property and equipment "Depreciation and amortization expense was $ 297 million" and intangible "amortization expense, which was $775 million" for 2025. The store value 297M (PP&E only) is not the D&A line.
rule_proposal: The 2026-11-12 ruling (D&A tagged with an accretion element = combined) conflicts here: the label names no accretion. Proposal: judge combined by the printed label, not the element name; serve the CF line.

rule_proposal: Derived from one filing (ruling 11): CF combined line minus the Subco distribution column of the same year equity statement, only when the two equity-statement amounts sum exactly to the CF line.
